title: How to identify content gaps for AI visibility
description: Learning how to identify content gaps for AI visibility starts with a question that traditional content gap analysis doesn’t always answer: where could a brand contribute something useful to an AI-generated answer, but isn’t being mentioned or cited?

title: Ahrefs Brand Radar vs. Profound: Which fits your team?
description: Marketers choosing between Ahrefs Brand Radar and Profound are really asking whether AI visibility belongs in your SEO suite or in a dedicated AEO platform. Brand Radar is the first option, Profound is the second, and HubSpot AEO is a third worth testing if you want visibility data connected to content and marketing workflows.

title: Which AI prompts should you track? A practical guide
description: For most teams, the answer to “which prompts should I track?” is this: track a representative sample of branded, unbranded, and competitor prompts across buyer stages, personas, and priority markets. Don’t fall into the trap of tracking everything.

title: 8 LLM visibility tools to track your brand across answer engines
description: Large language model (LLM) visibility tools track brand mentions, citations, and share of voice across answer engines. According to Digitaloft, 80% of users rely on zero-click results at least 40% of the time, meaning they often get what they need directly from a search engine results page (SERP) or an AI-generated answer. That behavior can leave marketers with fewer on-site signals such as clicks, scroll depth, and engagement rate.
